US 5Y minus CA 5Y is about 114bp after the same session (packet CA-US 5Y -122bp on Sep 16; US 5Y fell 8bp on Sep 17).

expression_comparison.chosen_because: The mispricing lives in FX not having stretched with a historically wide USD-CAD yield gap. Spot long USDCAD is with carry, with the delivered Fed/Canada policy split, and not a 99th-percentile chase. Cross-market receive-US/pay-CA is the pure coupon harvest but is long UST duration into a hike; outright duration and curve pay less or fight the catalyst. Vol is not unusually compelling versus this spot expression.

considered_rates.assessment: US 5Y 4.78% and 10Y 4.94% (2026-09-17) and AU 10Y 5.202% (2026-09-09) are the highest documented coupons, but US tenors sit at the 98th-99th 1y percentile into a live hike and hot CPI/PPI, so receiving outright UST fights the catalyst. AU 10Y is the fattest absolute yield yet the observation is eight days stale, AU inflation gauge is 82, and housing volumes/stamp duty are already contracting; the high coupon is compensation, not a free clip. Short duration is negative carry and is rejected unless a catalyst overwhelms it, which the already-priced 25bp hike does not.
considered_rates.instrument: US 5Y Treasury or AU 10Y government bond (receive outright)

considered_rates.assessment: US 2s10s is 27bp (1y percentile 1.39, z_1y -2.30) and CA 2s10s is 57bp (1y percentile 0.79). A steepener receives the long end versus 2s and therefore has modest positive carry of about 27bp (US) or 57bp (CA), but that is one-third to one-half of the cross-market USD-CAD pickup and a hiking Fed can keep 2s bid. Curve is a secondary, thinner-carry expression, not the book.

This is the fattest quantified carry differential in the packet: CA-US 5Y -122bp as of 2026-09-16, 1y percentile 0.20, z_1y -1.91; CA-US 2Y -139bp. Receiving US versus paying CA harvests 110-140bp instead of paying it. Rejected as the chosen expression because a long-UST / short-Canada RV still owns US duration into a hike and 98th-percentile UST yields; if the Fed-Canada gap widens further, that RV loses on MTM while USDCAD typically gains. AU-CA 2Y of about 167bp is even fatter but AU yields are dated 2026-09-09 and NZ RV is unavailable (RBNZ 403), so AU/NZ rates RV is not a complete book.
considered_rates.instrument: DV01-neutral US 5Y versus CA 5Y (receive US / pay CA)

considered_spot.assessment: Long USDCAD owns the same USD-over-CAD yield pickup without forcing long UST duration, and spot 1.3995 is only the 70.8th percentile 1y versus a 0.2nd-percentile CA-US 5Y gap. AUDCAD 0.9956 is a 97.8th/99.6th 1y/5y extreme and AUDNZD is a 99.8th/99.96th extreme: carry-is-king will not fade those (negative carry) but will not initiate them here. NZ yields are unavailable, so AUDNZD carry is unquantified and is refused. USDJPY/USDCHF carry cannot be quantified without JPY/CHF yields in the packet.
considered_spot.instrument: USDCAD (long USD vs CAD); AUDCAD/AUDNZD rejected as initiation

stance_summary: Clip the unusually wide USD-over-CAD yield pickup with a patient long USDCAD; do not fade that gap with negative-carry Canada-US rates RV, and do not chase 99th-percentile AUD crosses.
thesis: Verified fact: US 2Y/5Y/10Y are 4.67/4.78/4.94 on 2026-09-17 versus CA 2Y/5Y/10Y 3.35/3.64/3.92 on 2026-09-16; packet CA-US spreads are -139/-122/-109bp.
Verified fact: Fed hiked 25bp to 3.75-4.00% on Sep 16 with >90% prior pricing; US inflation/labor gauges 72/75 versus CA 55/38.
Inference: the still-wide yield gap is income that should be harvested, not faded; USDCAD has not already priced that gap the way AUDCAD has.
Unknown: FX forward points, implied carry, BoC cash rate, executable USDCAD, positioning, and NZ yields.

catalysts: Already-delivered Fed hike to 3.75-4.00% leaves a still-higher US 2Y (4.67%) as the path of carry rather than a new surprise.
US CPI/PPI/import-price sequence keeping a tightening bias versus Canada headline 3% / core near 2%.
Canada labor/consumer gauges (38/45) remaining soft enough that the BoC cannot close the yield gap quickly.
Saudi Oman workaround capping the extreme oil-supply tail that would otherwise re-bid CAD.

trade.horizon: Patient 1-3 month hold to clip the USD-CAD yield pickup through the post-FOMC window; extend toward 3-6 months only if the CA-US 2Y/5Y gap stays wide and US inflation/labor retain their premium versus Canada.
trade.invalidation: Thesis fails if the Fed pivots to easing, or the BoC hikes enough on energy pass-through that the CA-US 2Y/5Y gaps (packet -139bp / -122bp as of 2026-09-16) compress because Canada is catching US policy, or if US inflation/labor gauges lose their premium versus Canada without USDCAD having been paid the carry.
trade.mispricing: Verified CA-US 5Y of -122bp as of 2026-09-16 (1y percentile 0.20, z_1y -1.91) and CA-US 2Y of -139bp (1y percentile 4.76) coexist with ECB-reference USDCAD 1.3995 at only the 70.8th percentile 1y. Traders treating the yield gap as a mean-reversion sell-USD or receive-Canada trade are paying 110-140bp of negative carry; the cleaner holding-period distribution is to stay long the high yielder in spot, where the FX price has not already capitalized the gap the way AUDCAD (5y percentile 99.56) has.
principal_risks: 20d USDCAD realized vol is 5.28% versus a cash 2Y pickup near 132bp: FX noise can swamp a year of carry in days; this is income plus a rates-gap discrepancy, not a high-Sharpe carry machine.
BoC minutes already flag energy pass-through; a renewed oil shock can lift CAD and CA yields together.
ECB reference levels are not executable; live entry, forward points, and implied FX carry are unknown in this packet.
Temperature gauges are dashboard-retained and flagged stale_if_not_current_supabase; CA yields lag one session versus US 2026-09-17.
A US growth/labor break would cut USD yields and could unwind USDCAD even while the coupon was being earned.
trade.thesis: USD cash yields sit 100-140bp above Canada across 2s/5s/10s, the CA-US 5Y gap is at the 0.2nd percentile of the past year, and USDCAD spot is only at the 71st percentile 1y / 86th 5y. The market-vs-market discrepancy is that FX has not stretched with the rate differential. Long USD versus CAD is the patient, positive-carry way to own that stock of income after a fully priced Fed hike; fading CAD rates versus UST would require paying that same differential.
why_now: The Sep 16 FOMC 25bp hike to 3.75-4.00% arrived with >90% futures pricing, so the remaining edge is the stock of the USD-CAD yield gap, not a fresh surprise.
US 5Y/2Y yields remain near 1y extremes (98th/99th percentile) versus Canada 5Y/2Y at 3.64%/3.35%, so the carry pickup is fat while USDCAD itself is not a 99th-percentile chase.
US inflation and labor gauges (72 and 75) still sit well above Canada (55 and 38), with Canada August headline at 3% and core near 2%, so the differential is supported rather than a fluke print.
AU housing is already contracting and AUDCAD/AUDNZD are statistically maxed, so the high-carry AUD expressions are the wrong initiation; USDCAD is the cleaner carry book.

what_changes_my_mind: Official NZ or executable forward-point data showing CAD is not the cheap funding leg, or showing a fatter quantified carry elsewhere (AUDCAD/USDJPY) that is not already a 99th-percentile spot.
BoC hiking or energy CPI pass-through that closes CA-US 2Y/5Y toward mid-range while US gauges cool.
Fed easing or a US labor break that collapses the USD coupon advantage.
USDCAD stretching to AUDCAD-like 99th-percentile extremes with no remaining FX catch-up, at which point carry would argue to hold an existing long, not to add.
why_now: Post-FOMC, known hike information needs no new narrative; the holding-period return is the stock of USD-CAD carry plus incomplete FX catch-up.
Do not wait for a more exciting low-carry fade of CAD rates or a chase of 99th-percentile AUD crosses.
